See it in action

Find room for more.

Scan your library, explore suggestions and review selected folders. Saved photo analysis helps repeat scans focus on new or changed items.

Photo analysis runs locally. File AI requires iOS 26 or later and a compatible iPhone with Apple Intelligence enabled and ready.

A clearer look at your clutter.

Scan, review and decide at your own pace.

Private by design. Clear about limits.

The app scans the photos you allow and folders you select. It cannot clean other apps’ caches or scan the whole iPhone. File age means last modified, not last used. AI suggestions can be mistaken and do not establish that an item is safe to delete.
